global.description: Global settings applied to all sub-charts

storageClass.description: Default StorageClass for all PVCs. Empty = cluster default.

imagePullPolicy.description: Image pull policy applied to all components

imagePullSecrets.description: List of image pull secrets applied to every Deployment/StatefulSet

imageRegistry.description: Optional private registry prefix. When set, prepended to all image refs. E.g. 'my-registry.corp.com/kubeflow'

kserveDomain.description: Base domain for KServe InferenceServices. Prefer a scoped subdomain (e.g. 'models.example.com') over a bare org-wide domain ('example.com'): with kserveExternalHttps the cert is a '*.<kserveDomain>' wildcard, so a bare domain widens its blast radius to your whole zone. Pushed automatically to the knative-serving and kserve subcharts. Empty = fall back to the subchart-local knativeServing.domain / kserve.ingressDomain. Must not include a leading '*.' (the chart forms '*.<kserveDomain>' itself).

kserveExternalHttps.description: Enable external HTTPS to KServe inference on the dedicated kserve-ingress-gateway (global.kserveGateway.name), separate from the dashboard's kubeflow-gateway. When true, creates a wildcard cert (*.kserveDomain) and exposes it on :443, and flattens the route host to '{name}-{namespace}.{domain}' so the wildcard covers it. Requires a DNS-01 solver and global.kserveDomain.

name.description: Istio Gateway (namespace/name) for the Kubeflow dashboard and app VirtualServices. KServe inference does not use this — see global.kserveGateway.name.

Single source of truth (namespace/name) for the dedicated KServe/Knative inference gateway, separate from the dashboard's global.gateway.name. Threads through the Gateway CR rendered by kubeflow-istio-resources, the config-istio 'gateway.<namespace>.<name>' key net-istio binds inference to, and kserve's inferenceservice-config 'ingressGateway'. Keeping inference on its own gateway keeps the net-istio readiness prober off the dashboard's :443 TLS. Default 'kubeflow/kserve-ingress-gateway'.

email.description: Default Dex login email (DEMO DEFAULT — change in production)

passwordHash.description: bcrypt hash of the default user password

enabled.description: Enable NetworkPolicies (deny-by-default + explicit allows). Requires a CNI that enforces NetworkPolicy.

kubeDnsCidr.description: CIDR for kube-dns DNS egress allow rule

install.description: Install cert-manager via this chart (not recommended; install separately)

domain.description: Knative Serving domain for InferenceService external URLs. Normally left unset — auto-derived from global.kserveDomain. Only set for a standalone knative-serving install without the umbrella globals.

domainTemplate.description: Go template for the Knative route host. Normally left unset — auto-derived from global.kserveExternalHttps: empty uses Knative's upstream dotted form '{{ .Name }}.{{ .Namespace }}.{{ .Domain }}', and when external HTTPS is enabled the chart applies the flattened single-label form '{{ .Name }}-{{ .Namespace }}.{{ .Domain }}' so a single wildcard cert (*.<domain>) can cover inference hosts. Knative/KServe render this with Go's stdlib text/template (no Sprig), so the namespace cannot be hashed — name and namespace are joined by '-', which means two different (name, namespace) pairs can collide into the same host (see the README cross-tenant naming caveat). Set explicitly only to override; the flattened label must stay under 63 characters. Note '.Name' is the Knative Service name, so a serverless InferenceService component already carries its suffix here — a predictor renders as '{isvc}-predictor-{namespace}' (likewise '-transformer'/'-explainer'), so budget ~10 chars for that suffix against the 63-char limit.

ingressDomain.description: Domain for InferenceService external URLs. Normally left unset — auto-derived from global.kserveDomain. Only set for a standalone kserve install without the umbrella globals.

urlScheme.description: Scheme KServe reports in status.url. Normally left unset — auto-derived from global.kserveExternalHttps (https when enabled, otherwise http). Only set for a standalone kserve install without the umbrella globals.

sources.description: YAML string of catalog source definitions

db.description: Database connection settings (uses KFP's mysql-secret by default)

trainer.description: Kubeflow Trainer V2 — TrainJob CRD + controller

installCRDs.description: Install JobSet CRDs. Set false if JobSet is already installed.

enabled.description: Deploy the jobset-controller-manager alongside the trainer.

kubeflow-istio-resources.description: Istio Gateway configuration for Kubeflow external access

hostname.description: Host for the gateway. Leave empty ('') for wildcard/IP+NodePort access, or set a hostname: a dotted FQDN (kubeflow.example.com), a single-label name (kubeflow, localhost), or an IPv4 literal (10.43.1.7) are all accepted. Must not contain '*' — a literal wildcard hostname would make the auth-bypass filter trust every host. A bare public suffix (a single-label registry TLD such as 'com'/'io'/'co.uk') is ALSO rejected: hostname is seeded into the letsEncrypt ClusterIssuer's DNS-01 dnsZones (letsencrypt-ClusterIssuer.yaml), so 'com' would scope the ACME solver to the entire TLD — exactly what that template's comment warns against. The list is the common gTLD/ccTLD set, not the full Public Suffix List; the ClusterIssuer comment remains the backstop for the rest. The DNS charset is enforced (no whitespace/non-breaking-space/embedded-newline/trailing-dot/'_'/leading-'-'): the hostname is embedded verbatim into the authn EnvoyFilter's Lua, and an invalid character makes LuaJIT reject the inline_code so istiod NACKs the filter and the gateway falls open. Rejecting it here fails the install instead. Independent of TLS. Kept in sync with the sub-chart values.schema.json.

selector.description: Workload label selector shared by the Gateway and the authn EnvoyFilter. Must be non-empty: an empty/null selector on the istio-system authn EnvoyFilter (patches are context: GATEWAY) would attach ext_authz to every gateway in the mesh. Rancher Istio: {istio: istio}; upstream: {istio: ingressgateway}.

tls.description: TLS configuration for the Kubeflow gateway

source.description: TLS mode: empty=HTTP only, selfSigned=cert-manager self-signed, letsEncrypt=ACME, secret=BYO cert, issuerRef=existing cluster issuer

issuer.description: cert-manager ClusterIssuer name (required for selfSigned or letsEncrypt)

existingSecret.description: Pre-existing Secret name in istio-system (required for source: secret)

kserveExistingSecret.description: Pre-existing Secret in istio-system for the KServe wildcard server (source: secret + global.kserveExternalHttps). SAN must cover '*.<global.kserveDomain>'. Required in that mode.

credentialName.description: Secret name cert-manager writes to (selfSigned / letsEncrypt)

httpsRedirect.description: Redirect HTTP to HTTPS when TLS is active

letsEncrypt.description: Let's Encrypt ACME config (used when source: letsEncrypt). Chart creates kubeflow-letsencrypt ClusterIssuer automatically.

email.description: ACME account email — optional (recommended): Let's Encrypt issues without it; when empty the ClusterIssuer omits the field. Used for expiry-warning emails.

solver.description: Challenge solver: cloudflare (dns01, requires externalDns.cloudflare.apiToken) or http01

externalDns.description: Optional external-dns deployment for automatic DNS record management

enabled.description: Deploy external-dns to manage DNS records for kubeflow-istio-resources.hostname

name.description: DNS provider name (cloudflare, aws, azure, google, etc.)

domainFilters.description: Limit DNS management to these domains (recommended)

txtOwnerId.description: Unique TXT record owner ID — prevents conflicts in shared clusters

apiToken.description: Cloudflare API token. Chart creates a lookup-idempotent cloudflare-api-token Secret and auto-wires CF_API_TOKEN into external-dns.

env.description: Advanced: extra provider env vars appended after auto-wired vars
